description:
Perform a Chi-Square test for independence on the Titanic dataset to determine if survival was associated with passenger class. 

Starting state: Epi Info 7 is open. The dataset is available at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\titanic.csv'. 

Goal: 
1. Open the 'Classic Analysis' module.
2. Read/Import the 'titanic.csv' file (Format: 'Text File (Delimited)').
3. Generate a contingency table of 'Survived' (exposure/row) by 'Pclass' (outcome/column) using the TABLES command.
4. Locate the Pearson Chi-Square statistic, Degrees of Freedom (d.f.), and P-value in the output.
5. Create a text file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\chi_square_results.txt' with these exact three values (labels optional but recommended).
